Thanks for the tag, Jonas. I pulled the posting detail and here's what I see:

Summary of issue:
- Payment of $85,000 received 2026-09-29 (bank trace attached by customer).
- Auto-matching logic matched to INV-202608 because the ledger batch had an open credit memo for a short payment in the same range; manual rules favored the earliest outstanding invoice.
- As a result, AR aging shows INV-202608 paid in September, while INV-202609 remains open in October — creating an inter-period mismatch for revenue mapping.

Proposed corrective approach (option we prefer):
1) Reverse the cash application entry for INV-202608 (JE reference: PROPOSED-JE-2026-10-14-RV) to move the cash back to unapplied cash.
2) Apply the cash to INV-202609 (same gross amount).
3) Post a reclassification JE to ensure revenue recognition aligns with invoice dates if any revenue had been recognized prematurely.

Tax/VAT note:
- Both invoices are standard taxable in the US (no EU VAT here), but the timing of recognition vs cash application could impact month-end accruals. If we issue a credit memo + reapply instead, that creates additional VAT document flow which will complicate the customer's VAT reporting.

Attachments: I added a short workbook with the suggested JE lines and the GL accounts to be used (proposed-je-2026-10-14.xlsx). Also linking the working recon: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1a2b3c-HELIO-RECON and I've created JIRA FIN-1248 to track the execution and evidence for audit.

Marcus — can you confirm the GL accounts and raise the JE? Grace, please include the final evidence in the month-end pack.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
